attributes.action: STOP ANDY BURNHAM FROM ATTEMPTING TO TAKE THE UK BACK INTO THE EU AND BRUSSELS
attributes.additional_details: Rejoining the EU wouldnt resolve the UKs current economic challenges it would reverse the central premise of Brexit restoring EU control in trade regulation & strategic leverage Many of the issues we face stem not from Brexit  but from the fact that the UK has remained partially aligned in EU frameworks without fully exercising Brexit it was meant to deliver The UK is 1 of the EUs largest importers but EU partners would simultaneously seek 2 constrain the UKs economic & regulatory independence
attributes.background: STOP ANY DISCUSSIONS  ABOUT  REJOINING THE EU THE UK MADE A DECISION AND THAT WAS TO LEAVE THE EU THIS WAS A MAJORITY DECISION AND MUST STAND WE DO NOT WANT ANY OTHER COUNTRY DICTATING UK LAWS OR HOW THE UK CASH IS SPENT IF THE UK REJOINED THAT WOULD MEAN NO LONGER A SOVEREIGN STATE WITH NO BORDERS
